page.layout: Two parallel columns at the top: left column Greek text, right column Latin translation. Below them, one full-width block of running text in paragraphs. No margin notes. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right, gathering signature at the foot right. No catchword.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~60 letters] ἐὰν δὲ ἀλῷ, ὑμᾶτω ἡ Ἡλιαία, ὁ, ᾧ χρὴ παθεῖν αὐτὸν, ἢ ἀποτίσαι· ἐὰν δὲ ἀχρεῖος ὢν ἐμπῆ, ἀποδοῦναι τὸν, ἕως ἂν ἐκτίσῃ.

Heliastarum tribunal rapiunto: quicumque voluerit, & ei fas est, accusato. Eo convicto, Heliaste pronuncianto, quam meruerit poenam, aut multam: si multa irrogata sit, in vinculis habetor, donec eam solverit.

Legem habent Æschines [illegible, ~20 letters] & Demosthenes [illegible, ~15 letters] Timocratis. Solonis autem ea est, vt docet ibidem Æschines: [illegible, ~70 letters] Ea Lege notabantur infamia primum, qui nondum emeriti militiam detrectabant, [illegible, ~12 letters]. Sequuntur [illegible, ~6 letters]. Deus bone! etiā ignauiæ suæ, quæ forte à natura est, poenas dabunt ignaui: ita est, teste eodem Oratore: [illegible, ~50 letters] vt ex hac Lege constat.

Demum hac Lege tenentur [illegible, ~40 letters] qui deseruerant ordinem locumque suum: [illegible, ~80 letters] Meminit huius Legis Lysias: [illegible, ~30 letters] Demosthenes [illegible, ~20 letters] de Xenoclide Poëta: [illegible, ~60 letters] Idem de Rhodiorum libertate: [illegible, ~50 letters] Igitur [illegible, ~20 letters] vt ex hac Lege constat. Quod si quis [illegible, ~25 letters] & damnatus non temperaret sibi ab iis, de quibus hac Lege cautum, rapiebatur ab Vndecimviris ad Heliastarum tribunal, vt ei poena vel multa irrogaretur, vt habetur extremis Legis verbis apud Demosthenem, ad quæ scribit Vlpianus: [illegible, ~90 letters] Heliastæ [illegible, ~15 letters] vt ex hac Lege constat.

Legem colligere licet ex his Lysiæ verbis [illegible, ~20 letters] Θεσμοῦ--ντων [illegible, ~45 letters] non licet, ergo ignominiosus est; itaque alteri non licebat exprobrasse [illegible, ~20 letters] τὴν ἀσπίδα, vt in superioribus diximus, quod etiam vetat Francorum nostrorum Lex Salica, Tit. XXXII. Lege VI. Siquis alteri imputauerit, quod scutum suum proiecisset in hoste, vel fugiendo prætimore, CXX. den. qui faciunt sol. III. culpabilis iudicetur. Legibus quoque illi, qui nauali bello ordinem suum, id est, nauem deseruissent, aut huic militiæ vocati nomen non dedissent suum, ignominiosi erant:
Τὸ [illegible, ~40 letters] Qui arma abiecerit, ignominiosus esto.
In hunc censum etiam veniunt, qui arma abiecerunt.

page.notes: Greek text is very faint and blurred by a water stain running down the centre of the page; most Greek lines could not be read letter by letter and are marked illegible with approximate letter counts. The printed page number and running head are clear. The gathering signature "Aaaa iij" is at the foot right. The Google watermark at the bottom right is not transcribed.
